screening_summary_default: The screening was negative (no valid Kestrel or adVNTR data).
coverage_not_measured_note: Note: VNTR depth was not measured in this run, so it was not checked.

coverage_notes.reduced_no_finding: Reduced VNTR depth: {mean}x (adequate from {threshold}x). A variant with a weak signal can be missed at this depth.
coverage_notes.low_no_finding: Insufficient VNTR depth: {mean}x (below {threshold}x). A variant can be missed at this depth, so this result does not rule one out.
coverage_notes.uncovered: {percent}% of the VNTR region has no reads (limit {limit}%). Check the alignment there before relying on this result.
coverage_notes.action_no_finding: If a variant is still suspected, re‐sequence or test with an independent method: SNaPshot for dupC, long‐read sequencing for other variants.

length_estimation.label: Approximate total diploid VNTR repeat count
length_estimation.help: Research-only estimate of the total repeat count across both alleles. It does not affect variant calls or screening conclusions.

standard_length_estimation.help: Research-only estimate across both alleles; variant calls and screening conclusions are unchanged.

sources.local-research: Uses a locally fitted development model.

count_conventions.source-reported: Predicts assay-reported repeat counts; inclusion of terminal invariant units is unspecified.
count_conventions.complete: Predicts complete repeat counts including invariant units.
count_conventions.canonical-only: Predicts canonical repeat counts excluding invariant units.

standard_length_estimation.extrapolation_help: Some measurements are outside the model training range; the estimate involves extrapolation.

labels.typical_error: (typical error ≈{error} repeats, leave-one-out RMSE; not an interval)

caution.badge: Over {threshold} repeats: detection may be less sensitive
caution.help: Both alleles together are estimated at over {threshold} repeats. Kestrel detects frameshifts less reliably as the array grows.

high.badge: Over {threshold} repeats: long array, lower sensitivity
high.help: Both alleles together are estimated at over {threshold} repeats. In simulated arrays over 150 true repeats, Kestrel found 29 of 32 dupC variants and 11 of 23 other frameshifts.
high.notice_not_positive: The VNTR array is estimated at about {estimate} repeats (over {threshold}). Detection is less sensitive in long arrays, mostly for frameshifts other than dupC, so this result does not rule one out.
